config_coupling.effect: A nonempty override becomes an absolute database path. The resolver refuses an override inside a Git repository or worktree by probing the nearest existing ancestor with Git; a failing probe, including an absent git executable, admits the path. The calling databasePath function then applies store.AdmitStorePath before store or maintenance-state access.
config_coupling.source: Process environment CONCORD_DB_PATH, named by dbOverrideEnv; an unset or empty value selects store.DefaultPath instead.
